id: \bIt's a good thing we have Pokémon here to help us.
en: \bIt's a good thing we have Pokémon here to help us.
it: \bMeno male che qui abbiamo i Pokémon ad aiutarci.

id: \bRoark: Whew. Finally got that out of there.
en: \bRoark: Whew. Finally got that out of there.
it: \bPedro: Fiu. Finalmente l'ho tirato fuori di lì.

id: \bHi there. I'm Roark, the Gym Leader of this city. You came for a battle then.
en: \bHi there. I'm Roark, the Gym Leader of this city. You came for a battle then.
it: \bCiao. Sono Pedro, il Capopalestra di questa città. Allora sei venuto per una lotta.

id: \bI'll meet you back at the Gym. Let me give you a little something for making you come all the way here to get me.
en: \bI'll meet you back at the Gym. Let me give you a little something for making you come all the way here to get me.
it: \bCi vediamo in Palestra. Lascia che ti dia un pensierino per averti fatto venire fin qui a cercarmi.
